closure_definition: Same figures as the within-Baltimore tabs (single source of truth): equity subset — resident-initiated (Phone/API/Mail/Email), non-ECC, tract-geocoded; closed = SRStatus 'Closed' / 'Closed (Transferred)'; record-level pooled median.
Closed = a resolution date (RESOLUTIONDATE) is present. DC auto-resolves some request types, so median days-to-close is directional, not exact.
